scope: F2 fold-0 screen. Context-conditioned (hierarchical) kernel: a segment-local Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression predictor whose bandwidth is chosen per (Type of Travel x Class) segment, used as a standalone candidate and as an augmentation feature.

protocol.kernel: RBF kernel regression on the 21 standardized covariates, k-NN approximate (50 neighbors) Nadaraya-Watson weights; bandwidth h set per segment as the median k-NN distance within that segment (computed on outer-FIT rows only).
protocol.candidate: kernel-regression probability on fold-0 rows; equal-logit blend with route reference; also appended to 21raw as one feature for an LGBM xt_xt_f10 contrast.
protocol.training: all kernel statistics (standardization, neighbor structure, bandwidths) fitted on outer-FIT rows only; fold-0 rows only query.
protocol.cost_bound: NearestNeighbors on 560k x 21 with n_jobs=8; chunked queries.

frozen_decision_rule: PROMISING iff port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995 (candidate = equal-logit blend of kernel predictor with route reference).
